sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: DEEP RCKYS TROUGH WILL CONTINUE E INTO THE PLNS TODAY AND INTO THE MID/UPR MS VLY EARLY MON. IN ITS WAKE...ZONAL FLOW WILL OVERSPREAD THE WEST. SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW IN THE BASE OF THE TROUGH OVER NM SHOULD TURN NEWD THIS AFTN...REACHING ERN KS BY THIS EVE AND WI EARLY MON. SFC LOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPR TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE NNE INTO WRN ONT TODAY AS TRAILING POLAR COLD FRONT CONTINUES ESE ACROSS THE MID MS VLY...OZARKS...AND ERN PARTS OF THE SRN PLNS. THE SRN PART OF THE FRONT WILL OVERTAKE REMAINING PORTION OF PACIFIC FRONT OVER ERN OK AND CNTRL TX LATER TODAY. THE PACIFIC FRONT LIKELY WILL SERVE AS THE MAIN FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SVR TSTMS THIS PERIOD. ....E TX/ARKLATEX/SRN OZARKS TODAY/TNGT... MODERATE SFC-BASED INSTABILITY SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG/AHEAD OF PACIFIC COLD FRONT TODAY...WITH SBCAPE EXPECTED TO BE AOA 1000 J/KG FROM ERN OK/WRN AR S AND SW INTO E TX/WRN LA BY EARLY AFTN. COUPLED WITH GLANCING INFLUENCE OF NM UPR IMPULSE...AND ARRIVAL OF SOMEWHAT MORE MOISTURE-RICH RETURN FLOW /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW TO MID 60S F/...THE DESTABILIZATION SHOULD FOSTER INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS ALONG THE FRONT...AND/OR DEVELOPMENT OF NEW STORMS JUST AHEAD OF IT. 50-60 KT DEEP SWLY S

mesoscale_discussions.summary: N/S-ORIENTED BAND OF PRE-FRONTAL TSTMS MAY ACQUIRE TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES BY MIDDAY. ALTHOUGH BUOYANCY IS WEAK...STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR SHOULD PROMOTE A LOW-END RISK FOR TORNADOES AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: N/S-ORIENTED BAND OF TSTMS...ROUGHLY FROM 25 SW PRX TO 50 S CRS AT 16Z...HAS INITIATED IN THE PAST HALF HOUR. INTERPOLATED PROFILER/VWP DATA INDICATE FAVORABLE 0-1 KM SHEAR FOR LOW-LEVEL ROTATION. HOWEVER...WEAKNESS IN THE HODOGRAPH AROUND 2-3 KM AGL /ESPECIALLY WITH SRN EXTENT/ SHOULD LIMIT SUSTAINABILITY OF SUPERCELL UPDRAFTS WITHIN A WEAKLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. ALTHOUGH SURFACE HEATING IS BEING RETARDED BY WIDESPREAD CLOUD COVER...THERE IS CONCERN FOR A LOW-END TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND RISK THAT MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A WW ISSUANCE BY MIDDAY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AS THE COLD FRONT OVERTAKES A PERSISTENT PRE-FRONTAL BAND OF TSTMS...AN INCREASE IN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/BRIEF TORNADO POTENTIAL SHOULD OCCUR. THE SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY PEAK THROUGH ABOUT 00Z AS THE FRONT INTERCEPTS THE THERMAL/MOIST AXES EMANATING N/NEWD FROM THE WRN GULF COAST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PRE-FRONTAL LINE OF TSTMS EXTENDED FROM NEAR HOT TO 25 S TYR AS OF 2030Z. SEVERAL TRANSIENT LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATIONS HAVE BEEN NOTED ALONG THE LINE WITH ONE REPORT OF DAMAGING WIND THUS FAR. CONVECTIVE INTENSITY SHOULD INCREASE SOON AS THE SYNOPTIC COLD FRONT MERGES WITH THE LINE...INTERCEPTING THE SURFACE THERMAL/MOIST AXES THAT ARE EMANATING N/NEWD FROM SERN TX. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW S/SWLYS HAVE SUBSIDED SOMEWHAT AND A WEAKNESS IN THE 2-4 KM HODOGRAPH PERSISTS IN SHV VWP DATA...THE STRENGTH OF THE FLOW REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR LEWP/BOWING STRUCTURES PRIMARILY PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO. THE SUSTAINABILITY OF THE SEVERE THREAT DOWNSTREAM OF THE WATCH INTO PARTS OF CNTRL/SERN AR IS UNCERTAIN AS MODIFIED 18Z LZK RAOB SUGGESTS THAT THE AIR MASS IS ONLY MEAGERLY UNSTABLE. BUT WITH IMPRESSIVELY LARGE HODOGRAPHS SAMPLED IN THE LZK RAOB AND VWP DATA...A LOCAL AREAL EXTENSION OF WW 676 MAY NEED BE CONSIDERED. ..GRAMS.. 11/11/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THOSE PORTIONS WW BEHIND COMBINED COLD FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MAY BE CLEARED PRIOR TO SCHEDULED EXPIRATION. FIVE LA PARISHES AND ONE AR COUNTY WERE ADDED LAST HOUR PER COORD W/SHV. AREAS INTO WHICH CONVECTION HAS NOT REACHED MAY BE EXTENDED IN TIME AT WFO DISCRETION. OTHERWISE...REMAINDER WW CAN BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AS SCHEDULED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SFC MESOANALYSIS AT 00Z SHOWED PRIMARY BOUNDARY NEAR SRC-SHV-CLL ARC...MOVING EWD TO SEWD 15-20 KT. CONVECTIVE FORCING IS LOCATED WITHIN REGIME THAT IS INCREASINGLY ANAFRONTAL WITH SWWD EXTENT...AND SHOULD REMAIN SO...SUPPORTING DEVELOPMENT OF TSTMS ATOP CAA-STABILIZED BOUNDARY LAYER. COLD FRONT HAS CAUGHT UP WITH PRIMARY ZONE OF CONVECTIVE LIFT FROM ELD-SHV CORRIDOR SWWD...AND WILL DO SO FARTHER N AND E INTO ERN AR...WRN TN AND NWRN MS OVER NEXT FEW HOURS. AS SUCH...ANY SFC-BASED ACTIVITY THAT DEVELOPS ALONG FRONT WILL BE UNDERCUT QUICKLY. FURTHERMORE...FOREGOING BOUNDARY LAYER IS EXPECTED TO STABILIZE GRADUALLY WITH TIME...ESPECIALLY OVER AR AND NRN LA WHERE EARLIER RAINFALL INTO SOMEWHAT DRIER DEW POINTS HAS LEFT BEHIND SFC-BASED COLD POOL. THESE FACTORS SHOULD RESULT IN CONTINUING LOSS OF ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY ALREADY APPARENT IN REFLECTIVITY AND IR IMAGERY...IN PREVIOUSLY STRONGEST PART OF TSTM BAND FROM SRN AR TO EXTREME E TX. WEAK-CAPE/ADEQUATE-SHEAR REGIME IS EVIDENT...HOWEVER...IN ASSOCIATION WITH BELT OF CURRENTLY DISORGANIZED CONVECTION FROM CENTRAL LA SWD OFF COAST INTO ADJACENT GULF. WHILE BUOYANCY SHOULD BE WEAK...LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS WILL REMAIN AT LEAST MRGLLY FAVORABLE--MAINTAINING 200-250 J/KG 0-1 KM SRH EVIDENT IN LCH/POE VWP AS WELL AS LCH RAOB. 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES ALSO ARE FCST. HOWEVER...STRENGTH OF LIFT AND SUSTENANCE OF UPDRAFTS WILL BE QUESTIONABLE IN PREFRONTAL AIR MASS...GIVEN PRONOUNCED INVERSION BETWEEN 600-700 MB IN LCH RAOB AND LACK OF LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE AWAY FROM FRONT. WHILE EMBEDDED MESOCYCLONE/BRIEF TORNADO DEVELOPMENT CANNOT BE RULED OUT ENTIRELY...POTENTIAL APPEARS TOO CONDITIONAL/LOW FOR ANOTHER WW ATTM. ..EDWARDS.. 11/12/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RECENT INCREASE IN UPDRAFT INTENSITY HAS BEEN OBSERVED OVER PARTS OF SERN LA. THE PEAK IN STORM STRENGTH IS EXPECTED OVER THE NEXT HR OR SO WITH WEAKENING EXPECTED THEREAFTER. A WATCH WILL NOT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS A MOISTURE AXIS EXTENDING FROM S-CNTRL LA NNEWD INTO S-CNTRL MS. A COLD FRONT IS PROGRESSING SEWD FROM E-CNTRL MS INTO S-CNTRL LA AND WILL MOVE THROUGH THIS REGION OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. A LOW LEVEL CONFLUENCE ZONE HAS PREFERENTIALLY FAVORED A BROKEN BAND OF DEEP MOIST CONVECTION DURING MOST OF THE NIGHT...WITH UPDRAFTS STRENGTHENING RECENTLY AND RESULTING IN AN UPTICK IN LIGHTNING ACTIVITY FROM MAINLY I-10 NWD TO THE LA/MS BORDER. THE LAST HR WDSS-II 9 KM CAPPI AND ECHO TOP DATA ARE COINCIDENT WITH THE TREND IN INTENSIFYING UPDRAFTS. GIVEN THE STRONG LOW LEVEL SHEAR PROFILE PER KLIX VWP AND DEEP MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S...A ROGUE STRONG WIND GUST CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN MORE ORGANIZED NATURE OF QUASI-BANDED CELLULAR ACTIVITY. THE ENVIRONMENT WILL BECOME LESS FAVORABLE FOR AN ISOLD WIND GUST AS STORMS 1) CONTINUE EWD AND ENTRAIN PARCELS EMANATING FROM THE DRIER SERN U.S. SURFACE RIDGE AND 2) COLD FRONT UNDERCUTS ONGOING STORMS.
